scope: One-time opt-in native SpringBoard appearance diagnostic. Six unmodified full-screen captures inspected: four styles, restored Default, and final Home-page cleanup. No build/UI/test executed by reviewer.

originalState.iconSize: Small labeled icons, consistent with the Large app icons action and 64pt artwork in AX

restoration.method: Default selection and exact original size/wallpaper control label, value, and selection checked by passing diagnostic; restored icon and original wallpaper visually compared; panel dismissed and original Page 1 of 2 restored.
restoration.finalHomeLimit: Final unobscured capture shows original Page 1 of 2; Sayso is offscreen on Page 2. It proves native panel/page cleanup, not an unobscured final Sayso icon render.

limits: All four intermediate appearance captures retain Customize. The actual installed Sayso icon above it is the reviewed subject, not the generic appearance-preview thumbnails inside the native panel.

This establishes the four observed styles only: Default; Dark with Always; Clear with Light; Tinted with Light, wallpaper-derived gray and 100% luma. No other tint color, luma, wallpaper, large icon size, Clear Dark, Tinted Dark, or automatic appearance transition was tested.

No wallpaper control, icon-size control, appearance suboption, or tint slider was activated. Native style selection itself changes the available wallpaper action to Brighten wallpaper; restoring Default returns Dim wallpaper.

Static simulator captures do not verify continuous icon motion, physical-device display/lighting, or all user wallpapers. The native runtime signature verification error -67054 remains unresolved despite normal simulator execution; no security bypass was used.
This one-time system appearance diagnostic does not add a method to the implementation regression test count.
